Webex Connect and Cisco Contact Center Enterprise (CCE) integration currently supports three channels - SMS, Email, and Live Chat. Here are the details of how you can configure the channel assets for each of these channels within Webex Connect.

 | Channel | Documentation

 | SMS | SMS Asset Creation

 | Email | Email Asset Creation

 | Live Chat | LiveChat Asset Creation

 | Apple Messages for Business | Apple Messages for Business Asset Creation

 | Facebook Messenger | Facebook Messenger Asset Creation

 | WhatsApp | WhatsApp Asset Creation

## 📘
Web CallBack

Web CallBack is not a native channel of Webex Connect Please refer to the configuration related details on nodes in the Flow Configurations topic.
